highlights.title: The Bronx will be breathing a little easier with new Volvo VNR Electric
highlights.description: New York City’s largest food rescue organization is helping Bronx residents breathe a little bit easier with the recent acquisition and upcoming deployment of three brand-new, zero emission Volvo VNR Electric semi trucks. more…

highlights.title: Expect more upsells and subscription bundles from Apple, Creator Studio was just the start
highlights.description: In the future, Apple users should expect more paid upgrades and subscription bundles just like what the company launched with Apple Creator Studio last month. As said by Mark Gurman in this week’s Power On newsletter, “I believe Apple is looking at all areas of its software and services” for further services monetization opportunities.
